title: sdks-unify-auth-retries-streaming-ergonomics-parity-v1.179.0
author: Amelia Chen
description: Unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs and apply parity fixes plus version bumps to v1.179.0. Motivation: multiple downstream teams reported inconsistent retry behavior and streaming ergonomics between SDKs after recent runtime changes. This PR harmonizes the public surface, fixes edge-case race conditions in streaming cancellation, and bumps package versions. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce a shared Auth+Retry strategy interface and small adapter in each SDK to ensure consistent token refresh and retry backoff semantics. 2) Rework streaming client helpers to provide a single ergonomic streaming iterator/async iterator pattern across languages, adding explicit close/cancel semantics and better error propagation for upstream HTTP/GRPC failures. 3) Parity fixes: align Python and TS field names for streaming metadata, fix Go edge case where context cancellation didn't flush buffered events. 4) Docs and CHANGELOG updates and test coverage across unit + integration harness. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-1742) - [x] API compatibility smoke tests - [x] E2E streaming smoke test against local canary runtime - [x] Release notes drafted Testing notes: unit tests added for auth adapter, retry backoff, and streaming cancellation across all three SDKs; integration tests run in CI against the staging runtime and validated stable reconnect behavior. Backwards compatibility: public API maintained for previous ergonomics; the new streaming helpers are additive helpers with aliases to reduce churn. Rollout: canary release to npm/pypi/go proxy for one week before full rollout. Related Linear: ENG-1742, ENG-1801.
